Photo 1 shows the top dials and a lens with focus/zoom markings; the camera body is clearly Nikon Z fc.
Photo 2 shows the camera with accessories: a battery (labeled “Nikon”), a lens, and two lens caps (one appears to say “Ttartisan APS-C 35mm” on the cap).

read_from: photo 0 (visible “Z fc” text and Nikon branding)

claims.claim: Nikon z fc is a retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel aps-c...
claims.evidence: The photos show a Nikon Z fc body (photo 0/1), which matches the seller’s stated model; the megapixel/APS-C spec is not directly readable from the photos.
Photos show “Nikon” branding and “Z fc” on the camera body (photo 0/1), not Canon.

risks.risk: Wrong item / mismatch risk due to seller text claiming Canon while photos show Nikon Z fc.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the camera powering on with the menu screen visible (brand/model shown) and the serial number label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as Nikon Z fc only if confirmed; otherwise treat as not reliably matching and price at the worst-case (as a potentially mismatched/return-risk camera).

risks.risk: Shutter count / usage level unknown (affects value).
risks.proof: Ask for a screenshot of shutter count (or EXIF/firmware info) from the camera or a connected app.
risks.if_unproven: Price at a worst-case higher usage level (as used/unknown shutter count).

risks.risk: Lens identity and condition unknown (could be different lens than expected; caps suggest a Ttartisan lens but lens itself isn’t fully readable).
risks.proof: Ask for clear close-ups of the lens front ring and side markings (model/brand) plus a photo of the lens mount and glass for scratches/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the included lens being generic/unknown condition (worst-case: possible wear; no premium for specific lens).

risks.risk: Sensor health and internal dust/fungus unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a test shot of a blank white wall at f/16 and a close-up photo of the sensor (with lens removed).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if sensor may need cleaning (worst-case: not guaranteed clean).

risks.risk: Functionality (AF, IBIS, buttons, hot shoe, ports) not verified.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video recording showing: autofocus on a moving subject, IBIS stabilization (handheld shake test), and playback of a recorded clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested (worst-case: assume issues until proven).

risks.risk: Battery health/charging unknown (battery included but capacity/condition not shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of battery info (if available) or a video showing the camera running and battery indicator during use.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard/unknown battery health (worst-case: reduced capacity).

proof_requests: Power-on video with menu screen visible showing Nikon Z fc model/brand and firmware info.
Screenshot of shutter count (or equivalent usage metric).
Clear lens identification photos: front ring + side markings (brand/model), and close-up of lens glass for scratches/fungus.
Sensor check: photo of sensor (lens removed) and a test shot on a white wall at f/16.
Functionality video: autofocus on moving subject + playback of recorded video + quick check of ports/buttons.
response.reason: Photos clearly show a Nikon Z fc kit, but the seller’s text incorrectly says Canon and key value drivers (shutter count, lens model/condition, sensor health, full functionality) are not verifiable from the provided images. Missing proof prevents a confident worst-case price.
